steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: assert-time-restored-after-capture
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); if (s.timeMode !== window.__priorTimeMode || (s.timeMode==='manual' && s.manualHour !== window.__priorManualHour)) throw new Error('time state was not restored after capture: ' + JSON.stringify({timeMode:s.timeMode, manualHour:s.manualHour, prior:{mode:window.__priorTimeMode,hour:window.__priorManualHour}})) })()

steps.name: assert-time-still-restored-after-close
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); if (s.timeMode !== window.__priorTimeMode || (s.timeMode==='manual' && s.manualHour !== window.__priorManualHour)) throw new Error('time state drifted after closing the modal') })()
